notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for your support! I hope you enjoy playing my games.

If you have a moment, I’d really appreciate it if you could leave me a review. Even a few brief sentences can make a big difference in helping others discover the game!

Regards,

notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
Dear all,

I updated the game. Please, have a look at the changelog:

	- All the enemies are on the map and you can enter the battle system by 
                         touching them. They won't chase you during the game.

	- Pictures lighting is added to all weathers during the story of the game.

	- Gold and Exp points are increased by 50% when defeating the enemies 
                          (only first 5 chapter).

	- You will find some items to upgrade your weapons while exploring the 
                        maps.

	- More equipment are added.

	- Character potraits are added.

	- More artworks are added.

Enjoy.


Regards,
Abdulla
